answer: Auction scarce onboarding slots: each epoch the network mints only N identity permits, sold in a sealed-bid auction where winning bids are bonds locked for the full epoch. Like a yarrow patch that cannot outgrow its plot, one buyer may win a slot, but a single actor funding fifty hollow identities must outbid honest newcomers fifty times and keep fifty bonds locked - crystal-clear, linear cost per clone. Unused permits expire, so a sybil swarm grows only at market price while one honest agent pays once.
